translations.app.name: Palworld
translations.app.subtitle: Server Manager
translations.settings.title: Settings
translations.settings.subtitle: Desktop behavior and manager-owned storage.
translations.settings.appearance.title: Sphere theme
translations.settings.appearance.description: Choose a Pal sphere palette for highlights throughout the manager. This preference is saved on this device.
translations.settings.appearance.label: Application color theme
translations.settings.tray.title: Close to system tray
translations.settings.tray.description: Keep the manager and supervised servers operating when the window is closed. Quit fully from the tray menu.
translations.settings.tray.enabledNotice: Closing the window will keep the manager in the tray.
translations.settings.tray.disabledNotice: Closing the window will exit the manager.
translations.settings.launch.title: Launch at login
translations.settings.launch.description: Start the manager after signing in so worlds with autostart enabled can recover without manually opening the application.
translations.settings.launch.hiddenHelp: Adds --hidden only to the login launch.
translations.settings.launch.gpuHelp: Adds --disable-gpu as a renderer compatibility fallback.
translations.settings.launch.x11Help: Adds --ozone-platform=x11 for remote-desktop or Wayland issues.
translations.settings.launch.flagsHelp: Advanced Electron/Chromium flags, separated by spaces. Quotes are supported. Manager-controlled and remote-debugging flags are rejected.
translations.settings.launch.compatibilityHelp: Linux AppImage shared-memory and sandbox compatibility flags remain automatic. These options affect login launches only; manual launches are unchanged.
translations.settings.launch.enabledHiddenNotice: The manager will start hidden in the tray at login.
translations.settings.launch.enabledWindowNotice: The manager will start with its window open at login.
translations.settings.launch.savedEnabledNotice: Login launch options saved and the autostart entry was updated.
translations.settings.launch.savedDisabledNotice: Login launch options saved. They will be used if launch at login is enabled.
translations.settings.port.title: Manager web port
translations.settings.port.description: The desktop interface and authenticated remote screen share this port. Changing it requires a manager restart.
translations.settings.port.label: Port
translations.settings.port.labelHelp: TCP port used by the local desktop interface and authenticated remote administration. Valid values are 1024 through 65535.
translations.settings.port.savedRestart: Manager port {{port}} saved. Restart the manager to apply it.
translations.settings.retention.title: History and log retention
translations.settings.retention.description: Keep useful operational records without allowing the manager database and per-launch server logs to grow forever. The age and count limits are both enforced; whichever is reached first applies. Running operations are never removed.
translations.settings.retention.operationDaysHelp: Maximum age of completed operation records. Older operations are removed during cleanup; running operations are never removed.
translations.settings.retention.operationCountHelp: Maximum number of completed operation records retained across the manager. The age limit can remove them sooner.
translations.settings.retention.operationLinesHelp: Maximum saved console-output lines for each operation. Lower values reduce database growth but preserve less diagnostic output.
translations.settings.retention.activityDaysHelp: Maximum age of world activity, player-session, and related history records.
translations.settings.retention.activityCountHelp: Maximum activity records retained for each world and event category. The age limit can remove records sooner.
translations.settings.retention.logFilesHelp: Maximum number of Palworld process log files retained for each registered world.
translations.settings.retention.configVersionsHelp: Maximum restorable PalWorldSettings.ini snapshots retained for each world.
translations.settings.retention.help: Saving applies cleanup immediately. Future cleanup runs automatically every six hours.
translations.settings.retention.removedNotice: Retention policy saved. Cleanup removed {{count}} expired record or log file.
translations.settings.retention.removedNotice_other: Retention policy saved. Cleanup removed {{count}} expired records or log files.
translations.settings.retention.emptyNotice: Retention policy saved. Nothing currently needs cleanup.
translations.settings.data.title: Manager data
translations.settings.data.description: The manager keeps its database, SteamCMD, logs, and backups in its own data directory.
translations.settings.language.title: Language
translations.settings.language.description: English is built in. Additional validated PSM Next language packs can be installed without replacing application files.
translations.settings.language.label: Display language
translations.settings.language.labelHelp: Language used by the manager interface. Missing translations automatically fall back to built-in English.
translations.settings.language.fileHelp: Language packs are JSON files. Missing strings fall back to English.
translations.settings.language.removedNotice: Language pack removed; English fallback remains available.
translations.settings.language.invalidSize: Language packs must be smaller than 512 KiB.
translations.build.current: Installed build {{installed}} matches the latest public build.
translations.build.updateAvailable: Update required: installed build {{installed}}; latest public build {{latest}}.
translations.build.installedUnknown: The installed build could not be detected.
translations.build.latestUnknown: Installed build {{installed}}; the latest public build has not been checked.
translations.jobs.success.mod-download: Download verified and added to the Mods library
translations.jobs.dialog.noOutputHelp: This operation reports its result through the status above.
translations.operations.title: Operation history
translations.operations.subtitle: Progress, results, and command output for server management tasks.
translations.dashboard.title: Palworld servers
translations.dashboard.importDescription: Review the imported path and ports. Credentials are never stored in registration exports.
translations.dashboard.addDescription: Install a fresh dedicated server or register one already on disk.
translations.dashboard.installModeHelp: Download a separate Palworld server with SteamCMD.
translations.dashboard.adoptModeHelp: Register a folder containing PalServer without downloading it again.
translations.dashboard.name: Name
translations.dashboard.emptyHelp: Add an existing Palworld install or provision a new one.
translations.dashboard.registrationLoaded: Registration loaded. Review the installation path and ports before adding it.
translations.dashboard.registrationTooLarge: Registration files must be smaller than 1 MiB.
translations.dashboard.installStartFailed: World registered, but installation could not be started: {{error}}
translations.dashboard.noEligible: No worlds are currently eligible to {{action}}.
translations.structured.savedRestart_one: Saved {{count}} setting; restart to apply changes
translations.structured.savedRestart_other: Saved {{count}} settings; restart to apply changes
translations.structured.archiveTooLarge: Configuration archives must be smaller than 5 MB.
translations.structured.imported: Configuration imported; restart to apply changes.
translations.structured.restartRequired: Restart required — configuration was saved after this server started.
translations.world.pendingRestartHint: Settings changes are pending and will be applied during this restart.
translations.structured.changedOnly: Only changed fields are written. Unknown advanced INI options remain untouched.
translations.structured.reviewDescription: Only settings that will be written are shown.
translations.structured.searchDescription: Matches are grouped by their new tab and section.
translations.structured.unsetNoDefault: Unset — no usable shipped default is available.
translations.structured.unsupportedDefault: The shipped default is unsupported by this editor: {{value}}
translations.structured.templateUnavailable: The installed server template is unavailable or malformed. Unset values will remain unset.
translations.structured.schemaWarning: Compatibility warning: the installed configuration schema differs from this manager ({{keys}}). Unknown values are preserved.
translations.structured.passwordStorageNotice: Palworld stores these passwords as plaintext in PalWorldSettings.ini. Configuration history and full server backups preserve that file exactly.
translations.backups.title: Backups
translations.backups.description: Verified snapshots of this world's Saved directory.
translations.backups.destinationHelp: Leave blank to use isolated manager storage. Game installation paths are rejected.
translations.backups.retentionHelp: 0 keeps all backups. Retention runs only after a new archive verifies.
translations.backups.stopToRestore: Stop the server before restoring a backup.
translations.monitor.title: {{world}} operations
translations.monitor.description: Live server health, console output, and persistent operational history.
translations.monitor.noLogOutput: No log output has been recorded for this world.
translations.schedules.title: Automated operations
translations.schedules.description: Schedules run in the persistent manager runtime. Daily times use this computer's local timezone.
translations.schedules.noticeHelp: Uses REST chat fallback until the broadcast mod is available.
translations.schedules.messageHelp: Sent through Palworld REST as a System announcement.
translations.warnings.title: Warn players before maintenance
translations.warnings.description: For scheduled restart, stop, and update jobs, announce a countdown before Palworld's native final shutdown timer.
translations.warnings.defaultMessage: The server will {action} in {minutes} minute(s). Please get to a safe place.
translations.managerProperties.displayNameHelp: Optional local name PSM uses for this registration. Leave it blank to use Server Name and follow later Server Name changes; enter a value to keep a separate name.
translations.managerProperties.locationHelp: The path, platform, listener ports, and launch controls belong to this PSM registration, not PalWorldSettings.ini.
translations.properties.security: Registration exports include the installation path, platform, startup, launch, and environment settings. Passwords are excluded; environment variables may contain sensitive values.
translations.properties.platformHelp: Selects the server executable and configuration directory conventions PSM uses for this installation.
translations.properties.gamePortHelp: The local UDP listener used by players connecting directly.
translations.properties.queryPortHelp: The local query listener used for server discovery.
translations.properties.publicPortHelp: Leave blank to advertise and follow game port {{port}}. Set a different value only for NAT or tunnels.
translations.properties.communityHelp: Advertise this server in Palworld's community server browser.
translations.properties.portInvalid: {{label}} must be a port from 1 to 65535.
translations.properties.stopToEditNetwork: Stop this server before changing local listener ports or administrative network services.
translations.properties.stopToEditListing: Stop this server before changing community-listing or advertised-port settings.
translations.properties.restApiHelp: Enables Palworld's REST administration service for live server information and management actions.
translations.properties.restPortHelp: The local TCP port used by Palworld's REST administration service.
translations.properties.rconHelp: Enables Palworld's legacy RCON command service. It uses the administrator password from PalWorldSettings.ini.
translations.properties.rconPortHelp: The local TCP port used by the legacy RCON service.
translations.properties.autostartHelp: Starts this server automatically when PSM starts.
translations.properties.crashRecoveryHelp: Allows PSM to restart the server process after an unexpected exit.
translations.properties.performanceHelp: Adds PSM's legacy performance-related launch flags when starting the server.
translations.properties.extraArgsHelp: Additional command-line arguments appended when PSM launches PalServer.
translations.properties.wineBinaryHelp: Wine executable used to launch a Windows PalServer installation.
translations.properties.winePrefixHelp: Wine prefix for this server. Leave blank to use a prefix the manager owns and sets up automatically, without windows or installer prompts.
translations.properties.wineFlagsHelp: Additional arguments passed to Wine before the PalServer executable.
translations.properties.environmentHelp: Environment variables PSM supplies to the server process, represented as a JSON object of string values.
translations.properties.stopToEdit: Stop this server before changing ports, environment, or process-launch settings.
translations.properties.environmentInvalid: Environment must be a JSON object whose values are strings.
translations.properties.unregisterConfirm: Unregister {{world}}? Server files will not be deleted.
translations.world.stat.publicPortInvalid: Public port has an invalid value: {{value}}
translations.mods.title: Mods
translations.mods.description: What is installed in this world. Mods are added to the Mods library first, then enabled per world. Changes take effect after a restart.
translations.mods.changedNotice: Saved. Changes take effect on the next server start.
translations.mods.stopToChange: Stop the server to change its mods.
translations.mods.ue4ss.title: UE4SS (Lua mod framework)
translations.mods.ue4ss.installed: UE4SS is installed in this world
translations.mods.ue4ss.notInstalled: UE4SS is not installed in this world
translations.mods.ue4ss.libraryMissing: {{name}} {{version}} is not in the Mods library yet.
translations.mods.ue4ss.unmanaged: UE4SS is installed in this world, but not by PSM
translations.mods.ue4ss.unmanagedHelp: PSM does not track this copy. Replacing it moves the existing UE4SS files to the manager's mod trash and installs the library build.
translations.mods.ue4ss.enabledNotice: UE4SS enabled. It loads on the next server start.
translations.mods.ue4ss.disabledNotice: UE4SS disabled. Mods that need it stay installed but do not load until it is enabled again.
translations.mods.ue4ss.removeConfirm: Remove UE4SS from this world? Only the files PSM installed are deleted. Your Lua mods and UE4SS's log stay, but they will not load without UE4SS.
translations.mods.ue4ss.replaceConfirm: Replace the UE4SS files in this world with the library build? The existing files are moved to the manager's mod trash, not deleted.
translations.mods.ue4ss.stopToChange: Stop the server to change UE4SS.
translations.mods.ue4ss.recoveryPaused: Crash recovery is paused: the server crashed twice shortly after starting with UE4SS enabled. Disable or reinstall UE4SS, then start the server again.
translations.mods.ue4ss.binariesMissing: The server binaries for this build were not found. Install or update the server first.
translations.mods.ue4ss.linuxExperimental: UE4SS on the native Linux server uses a community port. Its file layout has not yet been confirmed on a running server, so this status may be incomplete.
translations.mods.ue4ss.warning.member-layout-missing: MemberVariableLayout.ini is missing. Without it, UE4SS can crash the server as soon as a Lua mod hooks a game event. Reinstall a complete UE4SS build.
translations.mods.ue4ss.warning.gui-console-visible: UE4SS-settings.ini has GuiConsoleVisible enabled. A dedicated server can crash on launch when UE4SS tries to open its console window.
translations.mods.ue4ss.warning.gui-console-unknown: GuiConsoleVisible could not be read from UE4SS-settings.ini. It must be 0 on a dedicated server.
translations.mods.lua.title: Lua mods
translations.mods.lua.needsUe4ss: Lua mods need UE4SS in this world.
translations.mods.lua.unmanagedHelp: These folders were not installed from the Mods library, so PSM does not track their version.
translations.mods.lua.availableHelp: Not installed in this world yet.
translations.mods.lua.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from this world? The folder is moved to the manager's mod trash; the library copy stays.
translations.mods.lua.replaceConfirm: Replace this mod with the library version? The existing folder is moved to the manager's mod trash, not deleted.
translations.mods.lua.inactiveDisabled: UE4SS is disabled, so these mods do not load. Their own settings are kept.
translations.mods.lua.inactiveMissing: UE4SS is not installed, so these mods do not load.
translations.mods.workshop.title: Steam Workshop mods
translations.mods.workshop.windowsOnly: Palworld runs server-side Workshop mods only on the Windows dedicated server build. They will not load on this server.
translations.mods.workshop.globalHelp: PalModSettings.ini's global switch. When it is off, no Workshop mod loads, whatever each one is set to.
translations.mods.workshop.inactiveGlobal: not loading while Workshop mods are off
translations.modLibrary.title: Mods library
translations.modLibrary.subtitle: Mods and frameworks the manager can install into worlds. Nothing is downloaded without your approval.
translations.modLibrary.runtimesHelp: Pinned, tested releases. Each world uses the build that matches its server platform.
translations.modLibrary.lua.title: Lua mods
translations.modLibrary.lua.help: UE4SS Lua mods you import here can be enabled in any world. Import a mod's .zip archive; it must contain Scripts/main.lua.
translations.modLibrary.lua.imported: {{name}} was added to the Mods library.
translations.modLibrary.lua.empty: No Lua mods have been imported yet.
translations.modLibrary.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from the Mods library? Worlds are not changed.
translations.modLibrary.removeConfirmInUse: Remove {{name}} from the Mods library? Worlds keep their installed copy, but repairing them later will need it downloaded again.
translations.modLibrary.downloadComplete: {{name}} was downloaded, verified, and added to the library.
translations.modLibrary.confirmDescription: This file comes from a third-party project. Review where it comes from before downloading it into the Mods library.
translations.modLibrary.confirmVerification: The download runs as an operation. The file is kept only if its size and SHA-256 match exactly; otherwise it is discarded. Nothing is installed into a world until you choose to.
translations.world.config.saved: Configuration saved; restart to apply changes
translations.world.config.restored: Configuration version restored; restart to apply changes
translations.world.backupRestoreConfirm: Restore this verified backup? A safety backup will be created first.
translations.players.title: Players
translations.players.offlineHelp: Start the server with its REST API enabled to view and moderate players.
translations.players.idHelp: Kick and ban use the player's REST user ID, not their display name.
translations.players.moderateHelp: Use this to unban an offline player or act on a known user ID.
translations.deaths.title: Death history
translations.deaths.description: Player deaths recorded for this world, newest first.
translations.deaths.emptyHelp: Deaths are recorded when the PSM Death Relay mod is running in this world.
translations.console.title: Live server log
translations.console.adminDescription: Uses Palworld's local REST API. Actions are recorded in world history.
translations.console.restDisabled: Enable REST API in Settings and restart the server to use these controls.
translations.console.rconDescription: Deprecated by Pocketpair. Prefer the REST controls above; this console is available only because RCON is explicitly enabled for this world.
translations.console.noResponse: Command completed without a text response.
translations.remote.login.title: Remote access
translations.remote.login.description: Enter the six-digit code provided by the server administrator.
translations.remote.title: Palworld worlds
translations.remoteSettings.title: Authenticated remote administration
translations.remoteSettings.description: Allow scoped access from another device. Existing manager pages remain desktop-only; remote users receive a restricted control screen.
translations.remoteSettings.desktopOnly: LAN binding is available only in the desktop application.
translations.remoteSettings.savedRestart: {{state}}. Restart the manager to apply the network binding.
translations.remoteSettings.disabledNotice: Remote access is disabled and all sessions were revoked.
translations.remoteSettings.bindingHelp: Choose whether remote administration listens only on this computer or on every local network interface. LAN access requires a manager restart when the active binding differs.
translations.remoteSettings.addressHelp: Addresses other devices can use after remote access is enabled and the selected network binding is active.
translations.remoteSettings.restartRequired: Restart required: the manager is currently listening on {{target}}.
translations.remoteSettings.createHelp: Create a revocable code for one person or device. The full code is displayed only once.
translations.remoteSettings.personHelp: A recognizable local label used in the access-code list and remote audit history.
translations.remoteSettings.worldAccessHelp: Limit the code to one registered world or permit its selected actions across every world.
translations.remoteSettings.permissionsHelp: Grant only the remote actions this person or device needs. Permissions can be removed later by deleting or disabling the code.
translations.remoteSettings.created: Access code created. Copy it now; it cannot be shown again.
translations.remoteSettings.codesHelp: Manage issued codes, revoke their active sessions, or remove access permanently.
translations.remoteSettings.codeDisabled: Access code disabled and its sessions revoked.
translations.remoteSettings.noCodes: No remote access codes have been created.
